correctness.rationale: PASS. Starting from the standard cyclic-normal-Sylow sum-of-element-orders formula, I independently derived gcd(A,psi(G))=gcd(A,psi(H)-psi(C_H(P))) because gcd(A,p)=1. For H=C_{q^beta} with action image q^gamma, the cyclic prime-power formula gives psi(H)-psi(C)=q^(2(beta-gamma)+1)(q^(2gamma)-1)/(q+1). The action implies q^gamma|p-1, hence A≡1 mod q and the q-power factor disappears from the gcd. Finally E=(q^(2gamma)-1)/(q+1)<q^(2gamma)<psi(C_{p^alpha}), so divisibility fails. I also rechecked the two cyclic-complement corollary reductions. An independent exact sweep of 669 compatible small parameter tuples reproduced the gcd and nondivisibility identities.

originality.rationale: PASS. Lazorec's accessible 2020/2021 ZM-group result gives a sufficient nondivisibility condition under an exponent-size hypothesis; the audited theorem removes that comparison for prime-power action images and gives an exact gcd independent of the action-kernel depth. The later psi-divisibility-graph paper still describes nonabelian psi-divisible existence as open and does not state this gcd theorem. The centralizer-difference identity is short, so an implicit antecedent under different notation remains a residual risk, which the record already acknowledges.

scientific_value.rationale: PASS. The exact gcd is stronger than a yes/no obstruction, cleanly isolates the action-image contribution, removes a published exponent restriction in a natural semidirect-product slice, and yields useful cyclic-by-cyclic corollaries. It does not solve the global nonabelian existence problem, but it is a meaningful structural advance.
